_help: Settings for the collector. Lines starting with _ are notes. Regexes are case-insensitive.
_include_bodies: Which meeting bodies to collect. '.*' = all (City Council + every committee).
_council_body: How to recognise full City Council meetings (vs. committees).
_vote_bodies: Roll-call votes are only downloaded for these bodies (keeps the job fast).
_final_passage: Which actions count as a final vote. Cincinnati uses 'Passed', 'Passed Emergency' (passed with an emergency clause) and 'Adopted'. Separate votes like 'Suspension of the three readings' and 'Emergency clause to remain' are excluded.
_vote_values: How Legistar vote words map to yes / no / absent / abstain / remote. 'remote' (taking part remotely, with no yes or no recorded) counts as present. Anything unlisted counts as 'other' (treated as absent).
_skip: Agenda/minutes lines that are not real items: ALL-CAPS section headers with no file number (ROLL CALL, AGENDA, MS. KEARNEY) are always skipped; lines matching this regex are skipped too.
skip_titles_regex: ^(council observed a moment|there being no objection|no announcements|the meeting (was )?adjourned|pledge of allegiance)
_terms: Council terms for the long-term trends view (Cincinnati elects all nine members every two years).
_stuck_days: An item counts as 'stuck in committee' when it was referred and hasn't come back for this many days.
_docs: Full text of legislation: max characters kept per document, max scanned pages read with OCR, minutes per daily run.
_summaries: AI summaries (Gemini free tier). summaries_public: show them on the site (false until the first batch is reviewed).
_transcripts: Meeting transcripts (closed captions CitiCable posts to archive.org): first date, minutes per daily run, and people whose names are never removed (besides Council members, who come from the database).
_refresh: Each run re-checks meetings changed since the last run, plus every meeting in this window (days back / days ahead).
